BEN.note: The national complaints mechanism is said not to replace the BCEAO's; no payments mandate, licensing or switch stated.

facts.fact: The Observatory for the Quality of Financial Services (OQSF), created by decree in 2020, presented an online portal on 29 July 2025 to receive and handle complaints from financial-sector clients, including e-money issuers' customers, with a mediation role.

systems.owner: OQSF, Ministry of Economy and Finance

BEN.note: No complaint figures or sanctions stated.
The portal takes complaints against financial providers, not public services.
Nothing on payments law or e-money rules.
E-money issuers named only as complaint focal points; no service status stated.
